intro: Lesson 16: Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه) accepts Islam. To understand how Umar came to Islam and why it gave the Muslims strength

questions.q: Explain how Umar's Islam helped the Muslims.
questions.a: He was strong and respected, so the Muslims felt safer and could worship more openly.
questions.model: Point: Umar's Islam made the Muslims stronger. Evidence: Ibn Mas'ud said they had been strong since Umar became Muslim (Bukhari). Explain: people feared him, so the Muslims could pray more openly. Link: Allah guides whom He wills.

questions.q: Write the story as a five-box storyboard on the pupil PDF (words and objects only: a scroll, a door, a path).
questions.a: Five boxes in the right order with a sentence each
questions.model: Teacher fills box 1: a path leading away from a house: 'Umar set out angry.'

questions.q: what does Umar's story teach about not giving up on people?
questions.a: Anyone can be guided; we should be kind and make du'a for them.

questions.q: why might the Qur'an's words have such power?
questions.a: They are Allah's words: true, beautiful and speaking to the heart.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: what changed Umar?
questions.a: Hearing the Qur'an softened his heart.
